request: 让 Codex Bridge 推理强度接口与 Aide 对齐：修复 Aide 到本地 OpenAI 兼容端点默认剥离 reasoning_effort 的问题，并核对取值和 off/auto 语义。
initial_status: Clean worktree on origin/main a05e9e68. Aide had no explicit provider setting for the Codex Bridge reasoning_effort contract; custom endpoints used legacy DeepSeek wire formatting, mixing the thinking extension with reasoning_effort.
acceptance: A model provider can explicitly opt into OpenAI reasoning_effort without changing legacy providers by default.

For Codex Bridge, Aide sends auto as omitted, off unchanged for the bridge's lowest-supported fallback, and minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max/ultra unchanged through streaming and non-streaming Chat Completions. Generic OpenAI format encodes off as none.
Codex Bridge's documented off fallback to the model's lowest supported effort remains compatible; unsupported reasoning stays unavailable unless explicitly configured.
Provider metadata survives settings save/read and applies to the provider selected by the session model.
scope: Aide provider metadata normalization/output, request formatting, focused Go tests, model provider settings control/localization, and architecture/task evidence
No Codex Bridge runtime change, no inference call, no release or production update

requirements.summary: Verified Codex Bridge validates reasoning_effort values and maps off to the lowest model-supported level, falling back to low. Aide had no explicit selectable provider format before this change.

design.summary: Add explicit per-provider OpenAI or Codex Bridge reasoning_effort format; preserve legacy default behavior. In Codex Bridge mode, auto is omitted and off is passed unchanged for the bridge's fallback; every intensity value accepted by the bridge passes through unchanged.

implementation.summary: Implemented provider format metadata, settings UI/locales, wire mapping and focused persistence/streaming tests.

verification.summary: Focused server Go tests passed in a clean Docker Go 1.26 container with network disabled. Final repository quick gate passed on the unchanged final code tree; JS syntax, locale coverage and diff checks passed. An unrelated random ciphertext test was made deterministic after it caused one transient quick-gate failure.

documentation.summary: Documented per-provider format choices and the distinct off semantics in the architecture guide.

cleanup.summary: Reviewed final diff and retained the implementation on the isolated local feature branch. No commit, push, PR, or release action was requested for this feature.

rollback: Discard or revert only branch fix/codex-reasoning-effort-alignment; the original dirty aide checkout was not modified.
handoff: Implementation and local validation complete on the isolated feature worktree. Not pushed or published.
